publications.title: When AI Is Your Pastor: A Benchmark for Theological Triage and Pastoral Guidance in Large Language Models
publications.summary: Introduces FMG-Bench to study how instruction settings affect model responses to theological and pastoral guidance questions.
publications.limitations: An English-language benchmark in Christian theological and pastoral contexts; its results do not establish pastoral competence or endorse models as pastoral authorities.
publications.reproducibility: The public FMG-Bench repository provides paper sources, benchmark data, a reference runner and scoring code. This catalog entry does not certify independent replication.
